summary: Iteration 13 — full backend + targeted frontend testing for new workflow (limbo/espletato/sospeso/guasto/migrazione), Saturday exclusion, mono_type dropdown, EXT materials, threshold alerts, team, users/approved, multi-serial paste, send-suspend-email, compose_note skip empty fields. Backend: 13/13 pytest in test_iter13.py passed. Frontend: admin login OK; StatsPanel has stat-espletati/sospesi/guasti/migrazioni counters, stats-from/to date pickers, preset-month & preset-15-15 buttons all present and functional. Threshold-input-CPE present in warehouse and setting value triggers backend notification (top-of-page toast '⚠️ Scorte basse: solo 0 CPE in stock (soglia: 100)' confirms end-to-end). Note card (expanded WR 17425036) shows all 4 status buttons (status-espletato/sospeso/guasto/migrazione-{wr}) and clicking migrazione toggles the MIGRAZIONE badge + toast 'Nota marcata come migrazione'. Edit form via edit-toggle-{wr}: field-note_date, field-mono_type (options exactly ['','MONO INT','MONO EST','SBR','VRT STR SBR']), add-material + material-row-{wr}-0 + remove-material-{wr}-0, plus private collapsible fields field-phone_client, field-apparato_password, field-id_servizio, field-id_risorsa all present. photo-lightbox / close-lightbox testids exist in source (not exercised — no photos on tested note). suspend-mail-{wr} button is conditional on isSuspended=true; note stayed migrazione during retry so button was not rendered — testid exists in source at line 892 and backend endpoint returns proper body for sospeso notes (unit-tested).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1324 lines — getting large, consider splitting into routers/models/services modules.
notes/stats aggregation loads up to 20000 notes to Python and classifies in-memory — OK for now but for scale prefer a Mongo aggregation pipeline (group by note_date/note_type).
compose_note correctly skips empty lines and appends materials as 'TIPO: SERIAL'.
POST /api/inventory/thresholds threshold=0 deletes; positive value upserts and triggers _check_threshold with 6h dedup — reasonable.
_check_threshold uses `note_wr` field to store tag name for dedup lookup — a bit of overloading; consider a dedicated `tag` field on notifications for clarity.
Multi-serial split regex r'[\s,;]+' handles spaces/commas/semicolons/newlines — matches the requested paste behavior.
TeamRequest allows empty partner_user_id (clears partnership) and deletes existing team rows for the day (idempotent) — good.
seed_data_creation: Created & cleaned up TESTI13_{ts}_A/B/C serials (tipo TESTI13) via multi-paste test. Created & cleaned up a test note via direct Mongo insert (WRTEST{ts}). Set & removed CPE threshold via API. UI test left WR 17425036 in 'migrazione' state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iter13 features verified: notes/stats totals+is_saturday+working_days_count, PATCH note_type<->status sync (guasto/migrazione/espletato/sospeso), multi-serial paste returns {multi:true,created_count:3}, thresholds CRUD + notification (kind='threshold_alert'), users/approved excludes self, team/today rejects self as partner and returns partner_ids/partner, send-suspend-email 400 when not sospeso and returns {to,subject,body} with OLO+WR+suspend_reason when sospeso, compose_note skips empty fields and adds materials. Frontend testids all confirmed. WR 17425036 currently in 'migrazione' state; may need reset for future tests.
